source.quote: The scholarship includes the following components for the complete duration of the course:- Compulsory non-refundable fees including tuition fee, as fixed by the Fee Fixation/Rationalization Committee of the State Government Academic allowance

summary.en: Register on the respective scholarship portal for issuance of a Freeship Card, and apply for the scholarship on the day of admission into the institution.
